name: main-gate

bypass._github_actions_not_listed: WORKFLOW-SCRIPT-FIXES-1: the github-actions app (id 15368) is not listed. GitHub refuses it as a bypass actor (POST /rulesets 422 'Actor GitHub Actions integration must be part of the ruleset source or owner organization', run 39269046255, 2026-10-19), so the dry run and the live run now agree: resolveIntegrations refuses a configured 15368 in both. The workflows that push to main with GITHUB_TOKEN move to a bypass-listed identity first (issue 100168, MAIN-RULESET-PUSH-IDENTITY-1); until then workflowPushPaths keeps live refused.

integrations.why: the code loop and the portfolio loop write through the qnfo-fleet GitHub App; its id is read from GET /orgs/QNFO/installations at apply time

_known_direct_pushers_why: GET /repos/QNFO/qnfo-workers/activity?ref=refs/heads/main, 2026-10-19: github-actions[bot] 47 pushes, qnfo-fleet[bot] 18 pr_merge + 5 push, rwnq8 28 pr_merge + 2 push. Live refuses when anyone else pushed directly, because the ruleset would block them.
_why_not_strict: strict_required_status_checks_policy true makes every pull request rebase whenever main moves (every few minutes here) and would stall the stale-PR lane; the checks already run on the merge ref.
_why_zero_reviews: one account authors every pull request in this fleet, so a required approving review could never be given; the required checks are the gate.
